name: Command console with three screens
brief: MK-066 Command console. Round 2, matched to the pick: one chunky framed console block with a raised hood holding three Earthlight screens and an orange status window, a sloped key deck of chunky coloured buttons, a lit service door below, and a little step in front so Abbie can climb up (adults stand, she climbs).

rounds.t: First build from the pack style and the Faceted Hero rules, no Midjourney pick yet.
Rebuilt against the Midjourney pick: chunky off-white modules held by dark bumper frames (bkit.module), warm orange windows (bkit.window), darker ground. Round 1 kept in round1/.

changes.t: Moved onto its pivot (footprint centre on the origin), the kit rule from the research pass; rebuilt.
